MATH_M1.stem: A weaver's loom is threaded so that the number of warp threads is a linear function of the width of the cloth. A cloth 45 centimetres wide uses 1,140 warp threads, and a cloth 70 centimetres wide uses 1,740 warp threads. How many warp threads does a cloth 100 centimetres wide use?
MATH_M1.check: Slope 600/25 = 24 threads per cm and intercept 60, so 60 + 24(100) = 2,460.

MATH_M1.stem: A gearbox designer writes the total backlash of a drive train, in microns, as \(\frac{6x^{2}-7x-20}{3x+4}\), where x is the number of meshing stages and \(x>2\). Which expression is equivalent to that backlash?
MATH_M1.check: 6x^2-7x-20 factors as (3x+4)(2x-5), so the quotient is 2x-5.

MATH_M1.stem: A cider press operator models the extra juice, in litres, obtained from n additional pressings of the same pomace as \(J(n)=-8n^{2}+192n-300\). How many additional pressings give the greatest extra yield under this model?
MATH_M1.check: The vertex is at n = 192/16 = 12.

MATH_M1.stem: A fisheries survey uses a tracer whose activity, in becquerels, d days after it is released is \(A(d)=6{,}250\left(\frac{1}{5}\right)^{d}\). After how many days does this model give an activity of 2 becquerels?

The path of a survey drone is modelled by \(y=x^{2}+4x-7\) and a taut guide cable by \(y=6x+8\), where x and y are measured in metres. The two paths meet at two points. What is the sum of the x-coordinates of those two points?
MATH_M1.check: x^2+4x-7 = 6x+8 gives x^2-2x-15 = 0, whose roots 5 and -3 sum to 2.

MATH_M1.stem: A pipe-flow chart converts a gauge pressure g, in bars, into a flow index F using \(F=\frac{5g-8}{3}\). Which expression gives g in terms of F?
A wind-tunnel report gives the drag index of a fairing as \(h(x)=3x^{2}-12x+5\), where x is the taper setting used on the model. What is the least value the drag index takes?
MATH_M1.check: The vertex is at x = 2, where h = 12 - 24 + 5 = -7.

MATH_M1.stem: A charity's endowment is drawn down at a rate of 18% of its balance each year, so that 82% of the balance is carried forward. The endowment is worth $12,500 now. To the nearest dollar, what will it be worth in 3 years?
A rope-walk twists 3 metres of finished cord from every 8 hanks of hemp, and hemp costs $6.50 a hank. What is the cost of the hemp needed to twist 21 metres of cord?
MATH_M1.check: 21/3 = 7 lots of 8 hanks is 56 hanks, and 56($6.50) = $364.

MATH_M1.stem: A commuter railway cut every fare by 15%, after which the number of journeys sold each day rose by 40%. The railway's daily fare revenue after both changes was what percent of its daily fare revenue before them?

How many of the pots fired in these four kilns cracked?

Over the first 8 days of a month, the mean daily rainfall recorded at a hill station was 4.5 millimetres. Over the first 12 days of that same month, the mean daily rainfall was 5.25 millimetres. What was the mean daily rainfall, in millimetres, over days 9 through 12?
MATH_M1.check: 12(5.25) - 8(4.5) = 63 - 36 = 27 mm over 4 days, so the mean is 6.75.

MATH_M1.stem: A stained-glass panel is cut in the shape of triangle \(JKL\). Angle J measures 40°, and angle K measures 3 times as much as angle L. What is the measure, in degrees, of angle K?
MATH_M1.check: 40 + 3L + L = 180 gives L = 35, so angle K measures 105 degrees.

MATH_M1.stem: A conservator props a straight brace against a vertical wall so that the brace makes an angle of 60° with the level floor and touches the wall 12 metres above the floor. What is the length of the brace, in metres?
MATH_M1.check: sin 60 = 12/L gives L = 24/sqrt(3) = 8 sqrt(3).

MATH_M1.stem: A sculptor casts a small bronze maquette that uses 350 cubic centimetres of bronze, then casts a finished statue similar to the maquette with every dimension 3 times as large. How many cubic centimetres of bronze does the finished statue use?
MATH_M1.check: The volume ratio is 3^3 = 27, and 350(27) = 9,450.

MATH_M1.stem: A rainwater butt is a right circular cylinder whose base has an area of 1,800 square centimetres. The butt holds 27 litres of water, and 1 litre is 1,000 cubic centimetres. What is the depth of the water in the butt, in centimetres?
MATH_M1.check: 27,000 cubic centimetres divided by 1,800 square centimetres is 15.

MATH_M2E.stem: A courier works out the fee for a parcel, in dollars, as \(5x-13\), where x is the mass of the parcel in kilograms. The fee for one parcel came to $42. What was that parcel's mass, in kilograms?

At a harbour market, mackerel costs $4 a kilogram and squid costs $9 a kilogram. A chef bought 5 kilograms of mackerel together with some squid and spent $65 in all. How many kilograms of squid did the chef buy?
A lighthouse keeper's logbook has 260 blank pages at the start of a season, and 3 of those pages are filled in each day. Which expression gives the number of blank pages left after d days?
MATH_M2E.check: Start at 260 and take away 3 for each day.

MATH_M2E.stem: A tram network sets the fare for a journey by the rule \(C(k)=1.80+0.45k\), where k is the length of the journey in kilometres and \(C(k)\) is the fare in dollars. What is the best interpretation of 1.80 in this model?
MATH_M2E.check: At k = 0 the fare is $1.80, the part of the fare that does not depend on distance.

choices.label: A

choices.label: B
choices.content: The fare, in dollars, charged for each kilometre travelled.

choices.label: C
choices.content: The total fare, in dollars, for a journey of 45 kilometres.

choices.label: D
choices.content: The fixed charge, in dollars, that applies to every journey however long it is.

MATH_M2E.stem: A gallery will hang an open show only if no more than 40 works are submitted. Which inequality gives all the possible numbers w of submitted works for which the show is hung?
MATH_M2E.check: No more than 40 means 40 or fewer.

MATH_M2E.stem: One third of the seats in a village cinema are in the balcony. The cinema has 42 balcony seats. How many seats does the cinema have altogether?
A church candle stands 30 centimetres tall when it is lit and burns down 2.5 centimetres in each hour that it is alight. How tall is the candle, in centimetres, after it has been alight for 6 hours?
A joiner cuts \(5m+8\) dowels for the frame of a cabinet and \(3m-2\) dowels for its shelves, where m is the number of shelves. Which expression gives the total number of dowels the joiner cuts?
A mosaic border has an area of \(6y^{2}-15y\) square centimetres, where y is its width in centimetres. Which expression is equivalent to that area?
A toboggan run's drag index is modelled by \(D(v)=v^{2}-3\), where v is the toboggan's speed in metres per second. What is the drag index at a speed of 7 metres per second?

A colony of mites doubles in size every hour, so after x hours the colony is \(2^{x}\) times as large as it was at the start. After how many hours is the colony 64 times as large as it was at the start?
The illuminance from a lamp d metres away, in lux, is modelled by \(L(d)=\frac{144}{d^{2}}\). What is the illuminance 4 metres from the lamp?
A stage crew's setup time, in minutes, is \(4(2p-3)+5p\), where p is the number of platforms being built. Which expression is equivalent to that setup time?
A struck tuning fork has an amplitude, in micrometres, of \(A(h)=80\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{h}\) after h seconds. What is the amplitude 3 seconds after the fork is struck?
A dyer's recipe calls for 3 parts woad to 5 parts water by volume. One batch made to this recipe uses 45 litres of water. How many litres of woad does that batch use?
A cycle shop's stock of helmets fell from 250 helmets to 210 helmets during one month. By what percent did the stock fall?

The lengths, in centimetres, of the seven pike caught during a river survey were 42, 55, 61, 38, 74, 50 and 66. What is the median of these seven lengths, in centimetres?
MATH_M2E.check: In order the lengths are 38, 42, 50, 55, 61, 66, 74, and the fourth is 55.

MATH_M2E.stem: A straight garden path runs into a long straight wall, meeting it at a single point and making two angles with the wall. One of those two angles measures 63°. What is the measure, in degrees, of the other angle?
An ornamental pond is a circle of radius 9 metres. What is the area of the pond, in square metres?
A shipping crate is a rectangular prism measuring 4 feet long, 3 feet wide and 5 feet tall. What is the volume of the crate, in cubic feet?
A carpenter stiffens a right-angled corner with a straight diagonal batten. The two arms of the corner measure 9 centimetres and 12 centimetres. How many centimetres long is the batten?
MATH_M2E.check: The batten is the hypotenuse: 9-12-15 is a right triangle.

MATH_M2H.stem: Two balance conditions in a chemical process are written as \(6x-4y=14\) and \(9x+ky=21\), where k is a constant. Every pair \((x,y)\) that satisfies the first condition also satisfies the second. What is the value of k?
MATH_M2H.check: The second equation must be 1.5 times the first, so k = 1.5(-4) = -6.

MATH_M2H.stem: A pressure transducer's calibration is a linear function f that turns a raw count into a corrected reading. The calibration record shows \(f(-1)=11\) and \(f(5)=-7\). What is the value of \(f(9)\)?

A joinery makes stools and benches from the same stock of oak. Each stool uses 3 board-feet of oak and each bench uses 8 board-feet, and at most 240 board-feet are available. The joinery must also make at least 3 times as many stools as benches. What is the greatest number of benches the joinery can make?
MATH_M2H.check: With stools at 3 times the benches, 9b + 8b = 17b <= 240 gives b <= 14.1, so 14.

MATH_M2H.stem: A tug leaves a jetty and travels along a straight channel at a constant 14 kilometres per hour. Two hours later a launch leaves the same jetty along the same channel at a constant 21 kilometres per hour. How many kilometres from the jetty does the launch draw level with the tug?
MATH_M2H.check: 14(t+2) = 21t gives t = 4 hours for the launch, and 21(4) = 84 km.

MATH_M2H.stem: A haulier charges $95 for the first 40 kilometres of any delivery and a fixed amount for each kilometre beyond the first 40. A delivery of 130 kilometres costs $455. How many dollars does a delivery of 200 kilometres cost?

A market stall's takings satisfy \(3a+5c=41\) and \(5a+3c=47\), where a is the price in dollars of an apron and c is the price in dollars of a cushion. What is the combined price, in dollars, of one apron and one cushion?
MATH_M2H.check: Adding gives 8a + 8c = 88, so a + c = 11.

MATH_M2H.stem: A kiln must be held at a temperature of at least 940 degrees Celsius and at most 1,060 degrees Celsius. The controller reading r and the temperature T, in degrees Celsius, are related by \(T=25r+540\). Which inequality gives every controller reading r that holds the kiln in the required range?

A calibration routine for a densitometer uses the two functions \(q(z)=z^{2}-2\) and \(p(z)=az+7\), where a is a constant. Feeding the reading 3 into q and then feeding the result of that into p produces 35. What is the value of a?
An optics model gives the effective gain of a lens stack as \(\frac{2x^{2}-18}{x^{2}+6x+9}\), where \(x>0\). Which expression is equivalent to that gain?
MATH_M2H.check: 2(x-3)(x+3) over (x+3)^2 cancels to 2(x-3)/(x+3).

MATH_M2H.stem: The floor of a tunnel has the profile \(y=x^{2}-6x+13\), and a survey laser is set at the constant height \(y=k\), with x and y in metres. The laser meets the floor profile at exactly one point. What is the value of k?
MATH_M2H.check: x^2-6x+13-k = 0 has one solution when 36 = 4(13-k), so k = 4.

MATH_M2H.stem: A rectangular allotment plot is 7 metres longer than it is wide and covers 330 square metres. What is the perimeter of the plot, in metres?
MATH_M2H.check: w(w+7) = 330 gives w = 15, so the plot is 15 by 22 and the perimeter is 74.

MATH_M2H.stem: A materials index is recorded as \(\frac{\left(27b^{6}\right)^{\frac{4}{3}}}{9b^{5}}\), where \(b>0\). Which expression is equivalent to that index?
MATH_M2H.check: The numerator is 81b^8, and dividing by 9b^5 leaves 9b^3.

The cable is 20 metres above the deck at \(x=0\). How many metres above the deck is the cable at \(x=50\)?
A culture of yeast triples in mass every 5 hours, and its mass is 12 grams at the moment the culture is started. Which function gives the mass of the culture, in grams, t hours after it is started?
MATH_M2H.check: The mass is multiplied by 3 once every 5 hours, so the exponent is t/5.

MATH_M2H.stem: A conveyor delivers crushed stone into a wagon at a constant 45 kilograms per minute. The wagon holds 13.5 tonnes of stone, and 1 tonne is 1,000 kilograms. How many hours does the conveyor take to fill the wagon?
MATH_M2H.check: 13,500/45 = 300 minutes, which is 5 hours.

MATH_M2H.stem: A researcher measured the wingspan of each of 60 randomly selected gulls from a colony of 900 gulls and found that 21 of the selected gulls had a wingspan of more than 140 centimetres. A grain hopper is a right circular cylinder of radius 3 metres and height 5 metres with a cone of the same radius and of height 4 metres fixed on top of it. What is the total volume of the hopper, in cubic metres?
MATH_M2H.check: Cylinder 45 pi plus cone 12 pi gives 57 pi.

MATH_M2H.stem: A draughtsman's set square is a right triangle \(LMN\) whose right angle is at N. The leg \(LN\) measures 24 centimetres and the leg \(MN\) measures 7 centimetres. What is the value of \(\cos L\)?
MATH_M2H.check: The hypotenuse is 25, so cos L = 24/25.

MATH_M2H.stem: A solid metal cube whose edges are 10 centimetres long is melted down and recast, with no metal lost, into a single solid rectangular block measuring 25 centimetres by 8 centimetres by h centimetres. What is the value of h?
MATH_M2H.check: 1,000 cubic centimetres divided by 200 square centimetres is 5.
